$comment: Central plan contract. Limits are design assumptions, not validated pricing. Prices are configured by environment (Stripe price IDs); amounts here are display defaults for the pricing page and must match the configured prices. manual_command_rate_limit applies per controller to non-coalescable actions; coalescable_command_rate_limit applies to actions that declare `coalesce` (sliders): the PWA throttles sliders to one command per 250 ms plus the final value on release.

pro.$comment: AI allowances stay 0 until the Phase E release gate; the cost model evaluates 250 interpretations / 30 minutes.

pricing_defaults.$comment: Pricing experiment inputs only. Live amounts come from the Stripe price objects referenced by DOME_STRIPE_PRICE_MONTHLY / DOME_STRIPE_PRICE_ANNUAL.

downgrade_policy.$comment: On Pro expiry the customer picks which 1 PC and 2 controllers stay enabled within the window; otherwise the most recently seen are kept. Nothing is deleted. Revocation and emergency stop work for every paired device regardless of plan.
